title: OP_EXPIRE
verdict: Needs current height or median-time-past and consensus expiry enforcement
gap: A chosen transaction nLockTime is a lower eligibility bound; it cannot enforce an upper expiry against current chain state.

title: OP_INOUT_AMOUNT
verdict: Expressible with existing amount primitives and checked 64-bit arithmetic
gap: Current-index cap and script preservation only; later bitmap-selected sum variants and full signed vault lifecycle are separate.

title: OP_EVICT
verdict: Expressible for the bounded two-member eviction
gap: Actual distinct P2TR output promises, both key subtractions and remainder signature; arbitrary group size and exact Script aggregation and setup are outside this profile.

title: TLUV
verdict: Expressible for one removal and internal-key update
gap: Other control-word variants, parity commitments and amount-preservation policy remain outside the tested mode.

title: 64-bit arithmetic draft (closed PR 2073)
verdict: Expressible for exact bounded signed widening multiply
gap: No claim of implementing every Script-number conversion or opcode variant.

title: OP_ZKP / OP_ZKPVERIFY
verdict: No complete pinned opcode; external verification-key lookup is unavailable
gap: Related field arithmetic and an explicitly estimated dense model do not constitute a Groth16 verifier or matching opcode.

title: OP_STARK_VERIFY / OP_GROTH16_VERIFY
verdict: A concrete bounded native STARK is expressible
gap: The custom M31/DEEP/FRI verifier does not implement Stone wire compatibility, unspecified verifier IDs or a full Groth16 pairing check.

title: M31 arithmetic opcodes
verdict: Expressible with existing word arithmetic; field overlays compared in isolation
gap: Native typed fields, no Script-number encoding or upstream conformance vector file.

title: OP_CHECKINPUTVERIFY
gap: Authenticated actual linked input; authorization for the sibling remains with its own spending condition.

title: OP_TX and companion opcode draft
verdict: Many fields exposed; full draft requires unavailable raw/context fields
gap: Exact raw input/output scripts require checked preimages; confirmation height and current chain context are not exposed; full selector interpreter unimplemented.
